instruction: A farmer has 17 sheep. All but 9 die. How many sheep are left? Explain your reasoning.
expected_answer: 9 sheep are left. The phrase 'all but 9 die' means exactly 9 sheep survive; the starting count of 17 is only there to mislead.

instruction: Explain the difference between supervised and unsupervised learning, and give one example task for each.
expected_answer: Supervised learning trains on labeled input-output pairs, e.g. classifying spam from labeled emails. Unsupervised learning finds structure in unlabeled data, e.g. clustering customers by purchase behavior. The key difference is the presence or absence of labels during training.

Penthos is an open-source coding AI built to solve software engineering problems with minimal unnecessary work. It combines local inference, tool use, an agent loop, an isolated Docker execution sandbox, and a verified training-data pipeline.
